notes.binary_max_bytes: 30 MiB ceiling; v0.1.8 binary is 22.6 MiB unstripped, GitHub release asset about 8.1 MiB.
notes.daemon_count_max: orderk is a one-shot headless CLI; normal runtime leaves 0 resident processes.
notes.rss_max_mb: 15 MiB ceiling for a single live search against the real vault. Measured VmRSS 9.2 MiB; this documents the product runtime budget.
notes.mock_stress_rss_max_mb: 32 MiB ceiling for release-gate mock stress (1000 notes / 300 queries / 12 concurrency). Measured max_rss_mb 22.75 MiB via ru_maxrss.
notes.mock_query_ms_p50_max: 150ms ceiling for mock-provider stress p50; measured 75.6ms with 1000 notes / 300 queries / 12 concurrency.
notes.mock_query_ms_p95_max: 200ms ceiling for mock-provider stress p95; measured 90.0ms.
notes.live_search_took_ms_ceiling: 5000ms ceiling for real provider (siliconflow) search; measured 1628ms. This includes embedding API round-trip and is provider-dependent.
notes.mock_stress: Reproducible deterministic baseline using mock embedding provider. Run: python3 scripts/stress.py. Real provider latency depends on API endpoint speed.
